LLRF.description: Live Load Reduction Factor (LLRF). Fields are driven by CALC_RULE (calculation rule), the applied force components, the live load cases, and a per-story reduction data table.

CALC_RULE.description: Calculation rule. Must be 0 or 1. When CALC_RULE=0, the RANGE_MAX/RANGE_MIN reduction range per story is applied; when CALC_RULE=1, RANGE_MAX/RANGE_MIN are ignored (fixed internally to 1.0/0.5).

APPLIED_COMP.description: Applied force components the reduction is applied to. Case-insensitive. Use ALL to apply to axial, moments and shear simultaneously; otherwise list the individual components.

LIVE_LOAD_CASES.description: Live load case names (must exist as static load cases). At most 5 are used; any beyond the first 5 are ignored.

STORY.description: Story name (must exist as a story).

XMIN.description: Minimum X coordinate of the reduction region.

XMAX.description: Maximum X coordinate of the reduction region.

YMIN.description: Minimum Y coordinate of the reduction region.

YMAX.description: Maximum Y coordinate of the reduction region.

RANGE_MAX.description: [CALC_RULE=0] Maximum reduction factor (Rmax). Only applied when CALC_RULE=0. Must be one of 1, 0.95, 0.9, 0.85, 0.8, 0.75, 0.7, 0.65, 0.6, 0.55, 0.5 and must be >= RANGE_MIN.

RANGE_MIN.description: [CALC_RULE=0] Minimum reduction factor (Rmin). Only applied when CALC_RULE=0. Must be one of 1, 0.95, 0.9, 0.85, 0.8, 0.75, 0.7, 0.65, 0.6, 0.55, 0.5 and must be <= RANGE_MAX.
